reason: The hypothesis proposes a novel integration of separately validated static (oxygen-induced) and dynamic (phonon) distortion descriptors into an ML model to predict conductivity of HfNbTaTiZr with 1 wt.% oxygen, a specific combination not proposed or studied in any passage. It addresses a gap by targeting conductivity prediction across a wide temperature range (0–1200 K) for an oxygen-contaminated alloy, which goes beyond the mechanical property focus of the literature.
